blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to Iguazu. On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel.

The same day, the programme introduces the Brazilian side of the falls. Iguazu means “big water” in Guarani. The system consists of 275 cascades, which can be seen from different viewing platforms.

The Brazilian route offers a broad panorama of the canyon and cascades. One of the main viewpoints is the Devil’s Throat. The paths bring you gradually closer to the falls, with the roar growing louder and mist rising above the gorge.

Return to the hotel after the tour.

On the Brazilian side, the view changes as you follow the trail. At first, sections of the cascades appear between the trees; then more and more water comes into view, and near the main platform the roar becomes almost constant. In sunny weather, rainbows form in the spray. This part of the route offers the overall panorama, making the following day on the Argentine side a very different experience.

The Bird Park and Macuco Safari can be booked at an additional cost.
